why: A bold label with no text after it sets the speaker when it starts with Miss, Madam or COL; those honorifics were missing from the speaker pattern, so the line was skipped and the speech went to the previous member.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr A: Hi there.

Miss Cheng Li Hui

Speech by Miss Cheng.

COL Tan Boon Huat

Speech by the colonel.

Madam Hoe Puay Choo

And madam.
